rungs.name: synthetic EAPOL-Key msg1 through the real builder/ring

steps: same boot as L2 after the dp chain

sleep 1; cat $D/data_tx_status; dmesg | tail -20
optional: monitor capture on the observer host (data frame to 02:00:68:69:35:02, LLC/SNAP 0x888e)
pass: probe rc=0; dmesg 'synthetic EAPOL-Key msg1 shape (113 B 802.3 -> data MPDU) posted'
data_tx_status: posts=1 completed=1 in_flight=0, eapol tx=1 msg1=1 msg3=0 4_4_like=1, unprotected=1
optional on-air witness; page golden, mask 0, AP alive
fail_if: posts=1 but completed stays 0 -> bounded timeout closes the lane: record POST-ONLY (missing peer/firmware context or descriptor field), no retry this boot

rungs.name: ndo_start_xmit without association: broadcast ARP TX COMPLETED
rungs.purpose: prove the real dev_queue_xmit -> ndo_start_xmit path with a frame that needs no peer and no encryption
rungs.params: data_tx=1 data_tx_peer=1 data_tx_protect=2 data_tx_timeout_ms=200 (force-clear protect so the MAC-encryption unknown cannot mask the result)
steps: fresh boot; boot chain; AP start + hostapd WPA2 AP; dp chain
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/24 dev __ap   # documentation range, local only
ping -I __ap -c 3 -W 1 192.0.2.10  # triggers broadcast ARP requests
cat $D/data_tx_status; dmesg | tail -20
optional: monitor capture of an unprotected ARP request from the AP BSSID
pass: data_tx_status: posts >= 1 completed >= 1 unprotected >= 1, eapol counters 0; dropped_peer may increment (the unicast echo is peer-refused - correct)
no timeout, lane not stalled; page golden, mask 0, AP alive
fail_if: posts>0/completed=0 -> record POST-ONLY, no retry this boot

rungs.name: real WPA2 4-way handshake (BLOCKED TODAY on the mgmt-tx lane)
rungs.purpose: hostapd EAPOL-Key msg1/msg3 through ndo_start_xmit; full 4-way; AUTHORIZED; ping with the on-air observer
rungs.dependency: the driver .mgmt_tx is fail-closed and there is no mgmt RX: a client cannot associate. Needs the mgmt-tx follow-up lane (WAL mgmt-tx family 0x01F2 and the D2H mgmt path). Expected result today: EXPECTED-BLOCKED at AUTH.
rungs.params: data_tx=1 data_tx_peer=1 data_tx_protect=0 data_tx_timeout_ms=200, sta_ops=1 eapol_rx=1 rx_enable=1
steps: start the AP (L2 chain + dp chain); confirm AP-ENABLED and GTK installed
observer WPA2-PSK association with the published fixture (ssid cudy-ap-test)
hostapd .add_station -> sta-ops user_add + asoc_syn committed (STA-ADDED)
hostapd msg1/4 -> xmit -> MSDU ring -> completion (data_tx_status eapol msg1=1)
drain RX: echo 1 > $D/dp_rx_drain repeatedly; msg2/4 reaches hostapd; pairwise PTK install (RX-only 0x0078); hostapd sends msg3/4
msg3/4 -> xmit -> completion (eapol msg3=1)
msg4/4 protected RX (firmware pairwise RX decrypt); hostapd PTKINITDONE -> RX_TX install -> .change_station AUTHORIZED
ping via the AP VAP with the authorized station; on-air observer captures the 4 EAPOL frames + protected data
pass: all four EAPOL frames observed; hostapd 'pairwise key handshake completed'
stations=1 authorized=1; data_tx posts/completed match; page golden/mask 0
unknowns_resolved: does the firmware encrypt a Protected-bit host-posted frame with the per-user pairwise/GTK key?
does hostapd msg3 (unprotected by its PTK-install ordering) still complete the handshake?
is an explicit firmware user context beyond .add_station required for host-posted unicast data?
does the MAC accept the frame subtype 0 shape?
